scope: Read-only scientific review of uploaded CARC CPU evidence; no new PDE solves or training

limitations: No independent Slurm sacct/accounting export or sampled CPU/RSS utilization is supplied. Resources are verified application requests; coefficient-cache bytes are not process peak memory.
The remote dirty flag is true. Fingerprinted execution source equals HEAD, but unrelated untracked/modified files on CARC cannot be identified from this archive.

Tower intentionally marked the large protocol manifest hash declared_unverified under its bounded adapter budget; this independent review rehashed and verified the protocol and all 17 inventoried artifacts.
These checks inspect stored measurements and plans; no PDE runs, training, new scientific tests, or changes to Tower/original evidence were performed.

cost.ratio_interpretation: ratio_b_over_a is b_seconds / a_seconds (>1 means a is faster); ratio_a_over_b is a_seconds / b_seconds (>1 means a is slower). Each matched target independently chooses measured nsteps per method; same-schedule ratios use identical nsteps. Summaries are medians of the explicitly labeled paired ratios.
limitations: Comparisons reuse conditions across norms, targets and schedules; counts are descriptive, not independent trials.
Scaling batch sizes share prefix members and grids share continuum patterns.
Setup cost is one sample; shifted timing ranges are not confidence intervals or setup-variance estimates.
FFT call counts differ from transformed fields and cells; cached tensor bytes are not process RSS or peak memory.
Fixed-grid reference-informed frontiers are not an adaptive deployable policy.

accuracy.scope: Derived from original stored FP64 numerical outputs only; no new PDE solves, training, thresholds or feasibility rules. Pair ratios use same case and nsteps; resolved differences means |error A-error B| > 2*recorded reference uncertainty, a descriptive review screen, not changed protocol acceptance. Approximation relative RMS is worst-member batch RMS difference / worst-member full-defect RMS, not largest individual relative error.
accuracy.approximation_scope: At initial input, h=T/4; error against full raw GL3 quadratic defect, not PDE endpoint. Normalized by worst-member full-defect RMS; ratio of batch norms, not maximum per-member relative error. One point per group/method, not per trajectory step.
accuracy.order_screen: p=log2(e16/e32); 10u is a post-hoc descriptive resolution screen applied to both errors, not a revised eligibility threshold. Finite-grid finite-range apparent orders do not establish asymptotic order. All reported RMS errors decreased across each available step doubling.
accuracy.amplitude_scope: Eight deterministic within-pattern/dimension pairs a=.04/.28 with all other inputs equal; slope=log(e(.28)/e(.04))/log(7), from one step, not a fitted universal exponent. Full GL3 slopes ~3 versus truncation slopes ~2 diagnose missing quadratic interaction versus remaining higher-amplitude terms.

compact_can_accidentally_reduce_pde_erro.interpretation: Truncation changes an approximate quadratic correction and can accidentally cancel other endpoint errors; closeness to GL3 and closeness to the PDE reference are distinct objectives. Resolved here refers to error difference >2u, not statistical confidence.

scaling_reference_horizon_limit.interpretation: Even Strang n2 meets strictest target 2e-6 with 7.7x maximum-error margin. This is a cost/scaling diagnostic on already easy accuracy targets, not evidence about matched-accuracy crossover at tighter targets, longer times or higher-frequency fields.

mechanism_recommendation: Promote fused full GL3 as an implementation control: it preserves full GL3 outputs, not mathematical accuracy order. Cost comparison remains separate.

Do not promote fixed low-input-mode truncation as general correction. Modes 9 and 10 both lie above K=8 yet their product has difference frequency 1. Restoring only exact raw GL3 k=0 mean cannot restore that spatial contribution.

For a next representation audit, select output frequencies after full-input quadratic mixing; preserve original finite cyclic convolution, fine-grid eigenvalues and mean/Jacobian weights. This retains high-high-to-low sources for selected outputs but still discards other outputs and has no automatic speed advantage.

Keep finite-amplitude and historical 2D failures. Full GL3 one-step empirical amplitude slopes 2.95-3.10 versus truncated ~2 support a separate finite-amplitude closure question; no uniform fourth order, positivity theorem or neural/FNO benefit follows.

Retain separate RMS and maximum evaluations. Adding raw GL3 mean improves every accuracy-panel K4-versus-no-mean comparison, yet can worsen scaling max error; analytic mean is not exact nonlinear endpoint mean.

A more discriminating future scaling protocol must make accuracy targets active and strengthen accepted references accordingly. Do not reinterpret current all-feasible targets as evidence of a crossover.

fourier_identity.normalized_coefficients: vhat_k=(1/N) sum_j v_j exp(-2pi i k.j/N), with multidimensional N the total cell count
fourier_identity.scope: Fourier coefficient of (E_s v)^2-E_s(v^2), exactly on original discrete cyclic grid with all multi-indices modulo axis lengths and lambda the kappa-scaled discrete diffusion eigenvalue. GL3 applies additional mean-dependent reaction Jacobians, transport exp(lambda_m*(h-s)), quadrature weights and endpoint subtraction. This expression alone is neither complete correction nor exact PDE evolution.

cohort_key_note: The accuracy.same_schedule reused_review aggregate denotes all 24 retained conditions, including four historical controls; it is not restricted to the literal row case_role reused_review.

recommendation.retain: Fused GL3 as an implementation control; retain original GL3 at the largest batch/grid where fusion reversed, plus Strang and prepared ETDRK4.
recommendation.mechanism: Test nonlinear full-input interaction or local spatial features before output compression; fixed low-input projection discards high-high sources of low output modes.
recommendation.scaling: A new bounded protocol must use reference-resolved accuracy targets/horizons/spectra that discriminate accuracy before interpreting a compact scaling crossover.
recommendation.limits: No neural/FNO, GPU, uniform fourth-order accuracy or population-wide solver advantage follows; all diagnostic choices remain frozen in this run.
